venture_hypothesis: A platform for experienced freelancers to find high-quality, long-term projects without competing on price. We connect premium freelancers with brands that value expertise and pay fairly.

proposed_features.name: Freelancer Profile & Portfolio
proposed_features.description: Freelancers create detailed profiles showcasing expertise and past work

proposed_features.name: Project Posting
proposed_features.description: Brands post project details and requirements

proposed_features.name: Matching Algorithm
proposed_features.description: Match freelancers to projects based on skills and fit

proposed_features.name: Messaging & Collaboration
proposed_features.description: In-platform messaging between freelancers and brands

constraints.tech_stack: React/Next.js frontend, Node.js/NestJS backend, PostgreSQL, Stripe for payments

success_metrics: At least 1 successful match and project completion
